name: inventory-status
title: InventoryStatus
description: Stock state chip for ecommerce / fulfillment surfaces. Five tones — in-stock, low-stock, backorder, preorder, sold-out. Each pairs a glyph + a label + the tone tint. Distinct from Badge (status pill, generic) — InventoryStatus encodes the standard commerce vocabulary so the Lumen library renders the same five tones across Shopify / BigCommerce / Woo surfaces.
